description: A rigorous expert-level AI literacy assessment with 160 items (20 per dimension) covering all 8 core AIQ dimensions with emphasis on advanced strategic thinking, organizational transformation, and thought leadership.

assessmentConfiguration.targetAudience: C-suite executives, AI research directors, chief strategy officers, organizational transformation leaders, AI governance experts

presentationMode.description: Advanced adaptive testing with sophisticated Item Response Theory (IRT) calibration
presentationMode.sequencing: By dimension, advanced adaptive difficulty and discrimination optimization

dimensionSequencing.description: Advanced candidates complete 20 questions per dimension in sequence with high-level adaptive calibration

scoringMethod.description: Advanced Item Response Theory with 3-parameter logistic model for expert-level discrimination
scoringMethod.formula: points = basePoints × (1 + difficulty × 0.5 + discrimination × 0.3 + c_param × 0.1) for each correct answer

scoringGuidelines.0-50%: Emerging Expert (0-800 points) - Significant expertise development needed

instructions: This AIQ Expert assessment evaluates your mastery of AI in advanced organizational and strategic contexts. You will answer 160 challenging questions (20 per dimension) in approximately 150 minutes.
